---
title: "Managing variants"
---

A project can contain multiple variants or scenarios. Variants store input configurations that can be loaded, edited and recalculated individually. The workflow is **create/define → save/load → simulate → compare**.

::: {.excel-path}
**Ribbon:** klimaaktiv PEQ → Projekt-Varianten → [Aktuelle Eingabe speichern]{.excel-action} / [Varianten]{.excel-action}
:::

## Comparing variants deliberately

First save a traceable reference. Create variants changing individual parameters or related measures, such as PV sizing or heat supply. This helps identify which change causes a difference.

Meaningful comparison requires aligned boundaries, reference areas, time bases and methods. Record tool version and calculation state. See [variant comparison](comparison.qmd) for evaluation.

## Creating and saving a variant

::: {.excel-operation}
**Where in PEExcel?**

1. Set project and variant names, clearly distinguishing baseline and measure.
2. Configure inputs on technical sheets and calculate.
3. Invoke **Aktuelle Eingabe speichern** (save current inputs) and assign the intended project.
4. Before confirming, check whether you are creating a new variant or overwriting an existing one.
:::

## Loading a saved variant

Select the project and variant in the manager and load it. Check names and loaded inputs; recalculate after changes or if results are out of date. Save unsaved changes before switching variants.

## Continuing work

[Presets](presets.qmd) help configure inputs. [Migration](migration.qmd) transfers projects to new versions. Use [comparison](comparison.qmd) for analysis and [batch simulation](batch.qmd) for many variants.

Source: [Training, slides 28 and 33](../downloads/schulung.pdf#page=33) (German).
